strategies_benchmarked.strategy: Strategy A: Rotated Packing at Grid Transition Boundaries
strategies_benchmarked.method: Multi-seed simulated annealing with translation/rotation moves
strategies_benchmarked.status: No candidate beat the tight integer grid boundary (L=4.0 for n=12, L=5.0 for n=20) within search budget.

strategies_benchmarked.strategy: Strategy B: Controlled Neighbour Transfer and Squeeze
strategies_benchmarked.method: Removal of boundary squares from n+1 followed by container re-bounding and HiGHS LP squeeze
strategies_benchmarked.status: Monotonic incumbent chain; single-square removals without angle relaxation leave perimeter constraints active.

strategies_benchmarked.strategy: Strategy C: Contact-Based Optimization with HiGHS
strategies_benchmarked.method: Linear programming compaction of square centers with fixed rotation angles
strategies_benchmarked.status: Rotated packings are already rigidly jammed along separating axes; fixed-angle LP degrees of freedom are zero.

strategies_benchmarked.strategy: Strategy E: Selective Coordinate Quenching / Local Refinement
strategies_benchmarked.method: Greedy hill-climbing with inward boundary nudges and angular perturbations
strategies_benchmarked.status: Incumbent rotated layouts correspond to exact algebraic local minima; greedy steps strictly rejected to prevent infeasibility.
